correctness.rationale: For an even continuous nonnegative speed density w positive off zero, inverse Brownian time change gives generator f''/w and conservative paths. Green kernel for Brownian killed at ±a yields expected threshold cycle m_a=int_0^a(a-x)w(x)dx and radial stationary f_T=r w(x)(a-x)1_(0,a), r=1/m_a. Independent Poisson resetting has even stationary density p_P=w h with h''=r w h>0, h'(0+)=-r/2 and h>0. F(x)=h(x)-r(a-x)/2 satisfies F'(x)=h'(x)+r/2>0 on (0,a), F(a)>0; normalization forces F(0)<0, hence one radial-density crossing; integrating signed single-crossing densities proves P(R_T>t)<P(R_P>t) for all t>0 and monotone-cost ordering. For w=|x|^alpha, alpha>=0, r=(alpha+1)(alpha+2)/a^(alpha+2). Fresh Brownian alpha=0 a=1 integration gives fT=2(1-x), fP=sqrt2 exp(-sqrt2 x), root 0.7579006016105, E[R_T]=1/3, E[R_P]=1/sqrt2, and strict survival inequalities in sample positions. The general proof uses convex resolvent, not finite mesh tests.
